description: The Sim Strategy: the simulation that guards the behaviour the analysis asks for, and what it displaces.

guard.description: The simulation that guards the problem.

guard_run.description: The guard's final 5× run and your reading of each of its replays; null when nothing could run.

replays.description: Every replay of the run, passed ones included.

reproduced.description: Whether the reported failure happened in this conversation, read from its turns and tool calls, not from the judge.

turn.description: The turn that decides it; null when the conversation never reached the point.

why.description: What the agent did at that turn, one sentence.

regressions.description: The simulations the change could break, and their baseline run.

sims.description: The guard left out; at most 240.

why.description: How the change could reach it, one sentence.

run.description: The baseline run id, the list run 5x before any edit; null when nothing could run.

file.description: simulations/<file>.tests.ts, relative to the agent directory.

id.description: The simulation id, existing or new.

old.description: The existing name, or null for a new simulation.

new.description: The name, or null when unchanged.

group.description: The describe block it sits in; a new simulation joins the existing group of its journey point.

gist.description: add: what the persona does and what must come of it, one sentence. modify: only when the persona changes. Else null.

persona.description: The customer from the call, not a paraphrase of the journey.

instructions.description: add: the full persona text. Else null.

changes.description: modify: the persona lines that change; empty otherwise.

openingTurns.description: Opening turns when the call fixes how it starts; empty otherwise.

mockUserId.description: The mock user the persona needs, or null.

why.description: modify, when the persona changes: what the persona as it is does that keeps the simulation from reaching or holding the scenario, one sentence. add: why this customer and not an existing persona, one sentence. Else null.

expectations.description: Expected outcomes and observations; an observation states the principle the agent must follow, names no tag, gives no reason.

tags.description: Tags asserted; a negative tag as !tag; never a tag that exists nowhere.

mechanism.description: What in this persona reproduces the failure turn's condition as the analysis states it.

covered_by.description: delete: the simulation that covers this scenario and what of it it already observes. Else null.

items.description: A simulation that will turn red by design.

why.description: What it asserts that the fix replaces.

expected_reds.description: Simulations that assert the behaviour the fix replaces; empty when none.

no_tag.description: The behaviour has no tag that can see it, so the guard rests on observations alone; say which tag the fix should add.

guard_quality.description: A judge or persona problem left in the guard after you iterated on it; null when there is none.

judge.description: Where the judge rules against the conversation, what you tried, and why it remains.

persona.description: Where the persona leaves the scenario, what you tried, and why it remains.

replays.description: The replay ids that show it.

fixture.description: The persona needs customer data or a mock user the harness does not have; name it.

multi_sim.description: The scenario cannot be guarded by one simulation; say why.

missing.description: Files you needed and did not find; empty when none.

no_repro.description: The guard stayed green on the tree as it is: the issue does not reproduce; say what the conversations did at the failure turn's point.

wrong_reason.description: After a second try the guard is still red for a reason other than the one the analysis names; say which.

feedback.description: How you weighed the feedback this run carries, as feedback.md says; null when it carries none.

verdict.description: accepted: every point; partly: some; disputed: none.

basis.description: For a dispute, the skill passage or the evidence (a turn, a block item, a run) that decides it, quoted; null for an accepted point.
